title: How to present your ideas effectively
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】如何有效地表達你的想法（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: If you can conjure up an exciting idea in someone’s mind, you have done something wondrous.
cues.en: If you can conjure up an exciting idea in someone’s mind, you have done something wondrous.
cues.zh: 如果你能在某人的腦海中浮現出一個令人興奮的想法，那麼你就做了一件了不起的事。

cues.text: A little piece of you has become part of them.
cues.en: A little piece of you has become part of them.
cues.zh: 你的一小部分已經成為他們的一部分。

cues.text: Connection, narration, explanation, persuasion, these are all great tools for sharing your ideas.
cues.en: Connection, narration, explanation, persuasion, these are all great tools for sharing your ideas.
cues.zh: 連結、敘述、解釋、說服，這些都是分享你的想法的好工具。

cues.text: But the most direct way of gifting an idea to an audience
cues.en: But the most direct way of gifting an idea to an audience
cues.zh: 但向觀眾傳達想法最直接的方式

cues.text: is simply to show them.
cues.en: is simply to show them.
cues.zh: 只是為了向他們展示。

cues.text: Many talks are anchored like this.
cues.en: Many talks are anchored like this.
cues.zh: 很多談話都是這樣進行的。

cues.text: You reveal your work to the audience in a way that delights and inspires them.
cues.en: You reveal your work to the audience in a way that delights and inspires them.
cues.zh: 您以一種讓觀眾高興並激發他們靈感的方式向他們展示您的作品。

cues.text: The basic name for this is revelation— the inspiring act of revealing something.
cues.en: The basic name for this is revelation— the inspiring act of revealing something.
cues.zh: 其基本名稱是啟示——揭示某事的鼓舞人心的行為。

cues.text: In a revelation talk, your goal might just be to create a sense of wonder and delight.
cues.en: In a revelation talk, your goal might just be to create a sense of wonder and delight.
cues.zh: 在啟示性演講中，你的目標可能只是創造一種驚奇和喜悅的感覺。

cues.text: If your talk is a demonstration, you're probably hoping to amaze and create a new sense of possibility.
cues.en: If your talk is a demonstration, you're probably hoping to amaze and create a new sense of possibility.
cues.zh: 如果您的演講是演示，您可能希望給人帶來驚喜並創造一種新的可能性。

cues.text: If you're sharing a vision of the future, you want it to be so vivid and compelling that your audience makes it their vision.
cues.en: If you're sharing a vision of the future, you want it to be so vivid and compelling that your audience makes it their vision.
cues.zh: 如果您正在分享未來的願景，您希望它如此生動和引人注目，以便您的受眾將其視為他們的願景。

cues.text: Let’s dig into three kinds of revelation talks.
cues.en: Let’s dig into three kinds of revelation talks.
cues.zh: 讓我們深入探討三種啟示性談話。

cues.text: 1. The Wonder Walk.
cues.en: 1. The Wonder Walk.
cues.zh: 1. 奇蹟步道 ．

cues.text: A wonder walk is a talk based on revealing a series of images or wonder moments.
cues.en: A wonder walk is a talk based on revealing a series of images or wonder moments.
cues.zh: 奇蹟漫步是一種基於揭示一系列影象或奇蹟時刻的演講。

cues.text: It can be like a studio tour with an artist guiding you through each artwork,
cues.en: It can be like a studio tour with an artist guiding you through each artwork,
cues.zh: 這就像一次工作室之旅，有一位藝術家引導您欣賞每件藝術品，

cues.text: or a hike with an explorer through a dramatic landscape.
cues.en: or a hike with an explorer through a dramatic landscape.
cues.zh: 或與探險家一起徒步穿越壯麗的風景。

cues.text: Each step is simple, with a sense of wonder building as you move from one piece to the next.
cues.en: Each step is simple, with a sense of wonder building as you move from one piece to the next.
cues.zh: 每一步都很簡單，當您從一件作品移動到下一件作品時，會產生一種奇妙的感覺。

cues.text: This type of talk is often used by artists, designers, photographers,
cues.en: This type of talk is often used by artists, designers, photographers,
cues.zh: 藝術家、設計師、攝影師經常使用這種型別的對話，

cues.text: and architects.
cues.en: and architects.
cues.zh: 和建築師。

cues.text: David Gallo gave a brief talk on underwater astonishments.
cues.en: David Gallo gave a brief talk on underwater astonishments.
cues.zh: 大衛·加洛 (David Gallo) 做了關於水下驚奇的簡短演講。

cues.text: He showed a series of incredible images and videos of bioluminescent sea creatures.
cues.en: He showed a series of incredible images and videos of bioluminescent sea creatures.
cues.zh: 他展示了一系列令人難以置信的生物發光海洋生物的影象和影片。

cues.text: A five-minute talk, it’s been viewed over 15 million times on YouTube.
cues.en: A five-minute talk, it’s been viewed over 15 million times on YouTube.
cues.zh: 這段五分鐘的演講在 YouTube 上的觀看次數已超過 1500 萬次。

cues.text: A wonder walk works best with a clear throughline—
cues.en: A wonder walk works best with a clear throughline—
cues.zh: 奇妙的步行最適合有清晰的貫穿線——

cues.text: a connecting idea that links all pieces together.
cues.en: a connecting idea that links all pieces together.
cues.zh: 將所有部分連線在一起的連線想法。

cues.text: Without that, it can get boring.
cues.en: Without that, it can get boring.
cues.zh: 沒有它，它會變得無聊。

cues.text: The goal is to give the audience an inside scoop.
cues.en: The goal is to give the audience an inside scoop.
cues.zh: 目的是讓觀眾瞭解內幕訊息。

cues.text: Using simple language, share your dreams, your process, and mistakes you made along the way.
cues.en: Using simple language, share your dreams, your process, and mistakes you made along the way.
cues.zh: 用簡單的語言，分享你的夢想、你的過程以及你一路上犯的錯誤。

cues.text: Illustrator David McAuley shared his drawings of Rome,
cues.en: Illustrator David McAuley shared his drawings of Rome,
cues.zh: 插畫家 David McAuley 分享了他的羅馬畫作，

cues.text: showing not just the finished works, but his mistakes and dead ends,
cues.en: showing not just the finished works, but his mistakes and dead ends,
cues.zh: 不僅展示了完成的作品，還展示了他的錯誤和死衚衕，

cues.text: and how he got from there to the published illustrations.
cues.en: and how he got from there to the published illustrations.
cues.zh: 以及他如何從那裡開始出版插圖。

cues.text: Letting your listeners in on your process is one of the major gifts of any creative talk.
cues.en: Letting your listeners in on your process is one of the major gifts of any creative talk.
cues.zh: 讓聽眾瞭解你的過程是任何創意演講的主要禮物之一。

cues.text: Don't just walk people through your work.
cues.en: Don't just walk people through your work.
cues.zh: 不要只是引導人們完成你的工作。

cues.text: Take them on a journey that sparks curiosity and inspires new ideas.
cues.en: Take them on a journey that sparks curiosity and inspires new ideas.
cues.zh: 帶他們踏上激發好奇心並激發新想法的旅程。

cues.text: 2. The Dynamic Demo.
cues.en: 2. The Dynamic Demo.
cues.zh: 2. 動態演示。

cues.text: If what you’re revealing is not just visual— like new technology or a novel invention—
cues.en: If what you’re revealing is not just visual— like new technology or a novel invention—
cues.zh: 如果你所揭示的不僅僅是視覺上的——比如新技術或新穎的發明——

cues.text: the audience wants to see it in action.
cues.en: the audience wants to see it in action.
cues.zh: 觀眾希望看到它的實際效果。

cues.text: Jeff Hahn demonstrated multi-touch technology in 2006, two years before the iPhone.
cues.en: Jeff Hahn demonstrated multi-touch technology in 2006, two years before the iPhone.
cues.zh: Jeff Hahn 於 2006 年示範了多點觸控技術，比 iPhone 早兩年。

cues.text: Pranav Mistry demoed Six Sense technology, showing the possibilities when combining a phone, a projector,
cues.en: Pranav Mistry demoed Six Sense technology, showing the possibilities when combining a phone, a projector,
cues.zh: Pranav Mistry 示範了 Six Sense 技術，展示了將手機、投影機、

cues.text: and a gesture-detecting camera.
cues.en: and a gesture-detecting camera.
cues.zh: 和一個手勢檢測相機。

cues.text: For a dynamic demo, what matters most is having something impressive to demonstrate.
cues.en: For a dynamic demo, what matters most is having something impressive to demonstrate.
cues.zh: 對於動態演示來說，最重要的是展示令人印象深刻的內容。

cues.text: If it's truly compelling, you can excite your audience with a small tease about what they’re about to see.
cues.en: If it's truly compelling, you can excite your audience with a small tease about what they’re about to see.
cues.zh: 如果它確實引人注目，你可以用一些關於他們將要看到的內容的小玩笑來激發他們的興趣。

cues.text: Michael Pritchard started his talk by asking his audience to imagine life without safe drinking water.
cues.en: Michael Pritchard started his talk by asking his audience to imagine life without safe drinking water.
cues.zh: 邁克爾·普里查德 (Michael Pritchard) 在演講開始時請聽眾想像一下沒有安全飲用水的生活。

cues.text: He poured muddy pond water, sewage runoff, and rabbit droppings
cues.en: He poured muddy pond water, sewage runoff, and rabbit droppings
cues.zh: 他倒了渾濁的池塘水、汙水徑流和兔子糞便

cues.text: into a container, then ran it through his Lifesaver bottle and offered it to an audience member.
cues.en: into a container, then ran it through his Lifesaver bottle and offered it to an audience member.
cues.zh: 放入一個容器中，然後將其倒入他的救生瓶中，並將其提供給一名觀眾。

cues.text: It tasted fine.
cues.en: It tasted fine.
cues.zh: 味道不錯。

cues.text: He demonstrated that the technology worked, then explained its potential to save lives globally.
cues.en: He demonstrated that the technology worked, then explained its potential to save lives globally.
cues.zh: 他證明瞭這項技術的有效性，然後解釋了它在拯救全球生命方面的潛力。

cues.text: A typical demo journey is: an initial tease, an explanation or context,
cues.en: A typical demo journey is: an initial tease, an explanation or context,
cues.zh: 典型的演示之旅是：最初的逗弄、解釋或背景、

cues.text: the demo itself , then the significance— the impact it could have.
cues.en: the demo itself , then the significance— the impact it could have.
cues.zh: 首先是演示本身，然後是它的重要性——它可能產生的影響。

cues.text: Exceptional demos can become visions of the future.
cues.en: Exceptional demos can become visions of the future.
cues.zh: 出色的演示可以成為未來的願景。

cues.text: 3. The Dreamscape.
cues.en: 3. The Dreamscape.
cues.zh: 3.夢境。

cues.text: Humans have the unique ability to imagine, invent, innovate, design,
cues.en: Humans have the unique ability to imagine, invent, innovate, design,
cues.zh: 人類擁有獨特的想像、發明、創新、設計、

cues.text: and envision worlds that don’t yet exist.
cues.en: and envision worlds that don’t yet exist.
cues.zh: 並想像尚不存在的世界。

cues.text: We can share these visions, inspiring others to believe and act, and sometimes, turn them into reality.
cues.en: We can share these visions, inspiring others to believe and act, and sometimes, turn them into reality.
cues.zh: 我們可以分享這些願景，激勵他人相信並採取行動，有時甚至將其變成現實。

cues.text: Screenwriters persuade studios to make movies.
cues.en: Screenwriters persuade studios to make movies.
cues.zh: 編劇說服片商拍電影。

cues.text: Inventors persuade companies to build inventions.
cues.en: Inventors persuade companies to build inventions.
cues.zh: 發明家說服公司進行發明創造。

cues.text: Architects persuade clients to finance buildings.
cues.en: Architects persuade clients to finance buildings.
cues.zh: 建築師說服客戶為建築物融資。

cues.text: Businesspeople energize teams with belief in a new vision.
cues.en: Businesspeople energize teams with belief in a new vision.
cues.zh: 商人以新願景的信念為團隊注入活力。

cues.text: Dreams can be communicated with images, demos, sketches, or words.
cues.en: Dreams can be communicated with images, demos, sketches, or words.
cues.zh: 夢想可以透過影象、演示、草圖或文字來傳達。

cues.text: Powerful speeches communicate a dream with inspiring language and passion.
cues.en: Powerful speeches communicate a dream with inspiring language and passion.
cues.zh: 有力的演講用鼓舞人心的語言和熱情傳達夢想。

cues.text: Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.’s speech at the Lincoln Memorial in 1963
cues.en: Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.’s speech at the Lincoln Memorial in 1963
cues.zh: 1963 年馬丁路德金恩博士在林肯紀念堂的演講

cues.text: lasted 17 minutes and 40 seconds, yet it changed history.
cues.en: lasted 17 minutes and 40 seconds, yet it changed history.
cues.zh: 歷時17分40秒，卻改變了歷史。

cues.text: Marine biologist Sylvia Earle used images and compelling language
cues.en: Marine biologist Sylvia Earle used images and compelling language
cues.zh: 海洋生物學家西爾維亞·厄爾使用影象和引人注目的語言

cues.text: to describe the ocean crisis.
cues.en: to describe the ocean crisis.
cues.zh: 來描述海洋危機。

cues.text: She invited the audience to imagine hope spots— protected areas for marine life.
cues.en: She invited the audience to imagine hope spots— protected areas for marine life.
cues.zh: 她邀請觀眾想像希望之地——海洋生物保護區。

cues.text: One audience member wrote $1 million check on the spot,
cues.en: One audience member wrote $1 million check on the spot,
cues.zh: 一位觀眾當場寫了100萬美元的支票，

cues.text: and protected ocean space has more than tripled since.
cues.en: and protected ocean space has more than tripled since.
cues.zh: 自那時以來，受保護的海洋空間增加了兩倍以上。

cues.text: Sharing a dream effectively requires painting a bold picture of the future
cues.en: Sharing a dream effectively requires painting a bold picture of the future
cues.zh: 有效地分享夢想需要描繪出一幅大膽的未來圖景

cues.text: and making your audience desire that future.
cues.en: and making your audience desire that future.
cues.zh: 並讓你的觀眾渴望那個未來。

cues.text: Visual aids can often help with the first part.
cues.en: Visual aids can often help with the first part.
cues.zh: 視覺教具通常可以幫助完成第一部分。

cues.text: Architect Thomas Heatherwick included a slide in his TED talk showing an elegant high-rise apartment complex
cues.en: Architect Thomas Heatherwick included a slide in his TED talk showing an elegant high-rise apartment complex
cues.zh: 建築師 Thomas Heatherwick 在他的 TED 演講中新增了一張幻燈片，展示了一座優雅的高層公寓大樓

cues.text: with curved buildings and a park at ground level, painting a future many listeners would be thrilled to inhabit.
cues.en: with curved buildings and a park at ground level, painting a future many listeners would be thrilled to inhabit.
cues.zh: 弧形建築和地面公園描繪了一個讓許多聽眾興奮不已的未來。

cues.text: That's the power of our dreams.
cues.en: That's the power of our dreams.
cues.zh: 這就是我們夢想的力量。

cues.text: They can spread to others.
cues.en: They can spread to others.
cues.zh: 它們可以傳播給其他人。

cues.text: They can build excitement and belief.
cues.en: They can build excitement and belief.
cues.zh: 他們可以建立興奮和信念。

cues.text: And through that process, they can come true.
cues.en: And through that process, they can come true.
cues.zh: 透過這個過程，它們可以實現。

cues.text: Now, Mix and Match.
cues.en: Now, Mix and Match.
cues.zh: 現在，混合搭配。

cues.text: Most talks don’t fit neatly into one category.
cues.en: Most talks don’t fit neatly into one category.
cues.zh: 大多數演講並不完全屬於某一類。

cues.text: Select, combine, and adjust talk types to best serve the idea you wish to convey.
cues.en: Select, combine, and adjust talk types to best serve the idea you wish to convey.
cues.zh: 選擇、組合和調整演講型別，以最好地服務您想要傳達的想法。
